recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: a programming language written entirely in nested folders
two chip giants settling a license dispute in court
browser engines built in parallel by different hands
clear autumn night over the bay at fourteen degrees
shipping deadlines measured in sunrise hours

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Compile a Folders-language program by nesting manila tabs into valid directory trees before the interpreter times out — each level unlocks a one-line output.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: watching a nonsense file tree resolve into a tiny running script in under a minute
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: depth increases and decoy folders with misleading names appear mid-round
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout manila tabs on graph paper

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Wake parallel agents from your phone before dawn — tap each node in sequence to spin up helpers and ship a build by sunrise.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: completing a chain triggers a miniature rocket-launch animation off the dock
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: overlapping agent timers compress the beat window and add off-beat decoys
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: terminal green glyphs on a pre-dawn orange gradient

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Two browser engines race the same page — swipe between lanes to collect shared components without letting either build break.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: every clean merge paints another layer of the webpage in real time
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: merge conflicts spawn as obstacles both lanes must dodge simultaneously
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: split-screen chromium blue versus warm coral panels

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick license fragments across a glass table before they crystallize — disputed patent shards bounce and multiply in the clear autumn night.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: successful catches fuse fragments into glowing circuit diagrams that pulse once
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: fragments bounce faster, split on impact, and edge toward crystallization
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: neon wireframe on black glass with faint bay fog
